title: The Depth Layer: Micro-Histories
use_cases: Use when detailing specific historical eras to add depth to a broader narrative timeline
Implement when creating foundational lore that justifies the current state of a fictional world
Configure when generating lore-driven artifacts or ruins that players/readers can discover
Use when developing complex NPC backstories based on historical hero/villain archetypes
Implement when simulating the long-term societal impacts of wars and natural disasters
content:
Once you have the macro timeline, drill down into specific periods:

```
"Focus on the period 200-250 years ago. Generate:
1. A major religious schism and its political consequences
2. Three legendary figures from this era (one hero, one villain, 
   one tragic figure)
3. A technological innovation that changed warfare
4. A natural disaster that reshaped borders
5. A cultural movement (art, philosophy, or science) that still 
   influences modern society

For each element, explain why it happened, who was affected, and 
what remnants exist in the present day."
```
